mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies at the Verona Public Library, a Waning Crescent moon, an overnight low of 62 degrees, and rain predicted overnight.

The City of Verona has several programs available including the rain barrel rebate policy, where residents can receive a credit on their utility bill for installing rain barrels, and the Verona Cemetery which is open for plot purchases to anyone.
We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today we have the Dane County Farmers Market and live music at several local venues. Tomorrow, head to the Verona Ice Arena for the free Girls Try Hockey event.
In our weekly look at local law enforcement, on Thursday July 31st, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to an arrest for O W I and multiple traffic citations for a Madison woman.
You can enjoy the Andes Mint Avalanche at Culver's today before they close at 10:30 PM. Also, don't forget you can find Kona Ice at Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4 PM.
